title: Heterogeneous latency-aware sampling protocol for production calibration packs
creator: Asha Patel
description: Define and implement a sampling protocol to curate per-domain calibration packs that preserve key production distribution features while controlling for latency sensitivity and tail-case accuracy. The protocol must be usable for FP8 and INT8 calibration workflows and compatible with the roll-forward accuracy validation harness.
background: Current calibration packs are aggregated via coarse domain-level stratification and uniform sampling; this results in over-representation of short, high-frequency prompts and under-sampling of latency-sensitive long-context requests and low-frequency but high-cost customer intents. For quantization (FP8/INT8) we need calibration sets that surface accuracy regressions that matter to product SLOs, not just overall token-level metrics.
proposal: Create a heterogeneous sampling pipeline that: 1) builds per-domain strata across three axes: semantic cluster (embedding-based), context-length bucket, and latency-sensitivity bucket (historical p95/p99 latency contribution); 2) applies signal-weighted reservoir sampling across strata to preserve rare but high-impact prompts; 3) enforces prefix-preserving sampling for multi-turn sessions so KV cache behavior is represented; 4) injects synthetic perturbations for low-coverage intent types (templated paraphrases) with explicit tagging; 5) maintains a reproducible seed scheme and metadata versioning to support backtests and rollbacks. The output are immutable per-domain calibration packs with provenance metadata used by calibration and validation tooling.

tradeoffs: Bias vs coverage: weighting rare/high-latency examples increases sensitivity to regression on tail cases but may decrease representativeness for overall token-level accuracy.
Storage vs reproducibility: storing immutable per-domain packs with full provenance increases storage and metadata overhead but simplifies audits and rollbacks.

Runtime complexity: embedding-clustering and prefix-preserving session reassembly add precomputation and pipeline latency during pack generation; mitigated by batching and scheduled generation windows.
implementation_steps: 1) Data ingestion: extend existing telemetry extractor to emit context-length, latency (p50/p95/p99), and session-id for prefix grouping. Owner: Mariana Silva. (PR: TBD)
2) Embedding pipeline: add nightly FAISS HNSW index build per-domain using production-embedding model; produce cluster ids. Owner: Research infra. (PR: TBD)
3) Strata definition: combine cluster id + length bucket + latency bucket into canonical stratum id. Owner: Liam. (PR: TBD)
4) Sampling engine: implement signal-weighted reservoir sampler with decay factor and capacity per stratum; expose tunables via config. Owner: Backend. (PR: TBD)
5) Prefix-preservation: implement session reassembly and atomic inclusion of full prefix up to max context length during sampling. Owner: Serving infra. (PR: TBD)
6) Synthetic augmentation: small templating service to generate paraphrases for low-frequency intents; mark generated items in metadata. Owner: Applied ML. (PR: TBD)
7) Pack materialization: emit JSONL packs + CSV manifest with provenance, sampling seeds, and stratum counts; upload to S3 with lifecycle policy. Owner: Data infra. (PR: TBD)
8) Validation harness: run FP8/INT8 calibration+eval runs against new packs, record MRR/EM/ROUGE and per-intent accuracy; tie into regression alerting. Owner: QA/Applied ML. (PR: TBD)
9) Docs and runbook: publish pack generation docs, tuning guide, and rollback steps. Owner: DevEx.
rollout_plan: Start with three pilot domains (chat-assistant, code-gen, email-summarization). Generate baseline packs and compare against legacy packs in the roll-forward validation harness. Run a two-week shadow calibration and validation cycle; if tail-regression reduction >= 20% or critical-intent accuracy improves without degrading overall metrics beyond defined thresholds, expand to 20 domains. Full production sweep scheduled after two successful cycles.
metrics: per-domain critical-intent accuracy (top-1) before vs after quantization
p95/p99 latency delta for sampled requests in simulator (to track latency-regression sensitivity)
distributional coverage: fraction of unique intents covered vs production corpus
regression detection rate: number of actionable regressions surfaced per calibration run
pack reproducibility: checksum/seed validation success rate
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline produces immutable per-domain calibration packs with manifest and provenance metadata for pilot domains
Sampling preserves at least 95% of unique critical-intents present in production for pilot domains
Roll-forward validation shows improved detection of FP8/INT8 regressions on tail intents (>=20% improvement in detection rate) without >1% degradation in aggregate metric
End-to-end generation completes within nightly window (<= 3 hours for pilot domains)
QA_plan: Unit tests for strata assignment and reservoir sampler determinism
Integration tests verifying session reassembly and prefix-preservation behavior
Repro runs: regenerate packs from same seed and compare checksums
Manual spot-check: sample 200 prompts per domain and verify labeling (synthetic flag, stratum id)
Calibration-then-eval runs for FP8 and INT8 quantization profiles using standard eval harness
